# `missingEffectServiceDependency`

Checks that Effect.Service dependencies satisfy all required layer inputs

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `off` |
| Fixable | No |
| Effect versions | v3 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377039`, `TS377040` |
| Language Service name | `missingEffectServiceDependency` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/missing-effect-service-dependency` |

## Preview

```ts
import * as Effect from "effect/Effect"

class Db extends Effect.Service<Db>()("Db", { succeed: { ok: true } }) {}
export class Repo extends Effect.Service<Repo>()("Repo", {
/**
             ^^^^ effecttsgo(missing-effect-service-dependency): Service 'Db' is required but not provided by dependencies.
*/
  effect: Effect.gen(function*() {
    yield* Db
    return { all: Effect.succeed([] as Array<number>) }
  })
}) {}
```

## Language Service Configuration

See the [Language Service setup guide](../../README.md#installation) for installation instructions.

```jsonc
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "plugins": [
      {
        "name": "@effect/language-service",
        "diagnosticSeverity": {
          "missingEffectServiceDependency": "warning"
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## Oxlint Configuration

See the [Oxlint setup guide](../README.md#oxlint-setup) for installation and patching instructions.

```json
{
  "options": {
    "typeAware": true
  },
  "plugins": ["effecttsgo"],
  "rules": {
    "effecttsgo/missing-effect-service-dependency": "warn"
  }
}
```
